name: Barnier
source:
The lord of the land, referred to by many as ”the second coming of the great tyrant of old.”

He tortures and murders slaves for his own perverse enjoyment, and he regularly hosts banquets at his estate, inviting other nobles with similar predilections.

Barnier killed the former lord, as well as all of his close associates and their families.

[From [url=http://www.mangagamer.com/detail.php?goods_type=1&product_code=1053/]MangaGamer[/url]]

[spoiler]His full name is Jean-François Barnier.[/spoiler]
